label: Nivolumab SC (Opdivo Qvantig) — FDA CheckMate-67T model · 2-compartment SC/IV · time-varying CL
_note: The model behind the SC approval: fitted to CheckMate-67T (2L clear-cell RCC, SC 1200 mg Q4W vs IV 3 mg/kg Q2W) with priors from the pooled model. Converted from hours to days.

_source.document: FDA Multi-disciplinary Review BLA 761381/761429 (OPDIVO QVANTIG, Reference ID 5502908)
_source.subjects: 487 patients with 2L clear-cell RCC (245 IV, 242 SC), 3734 samples; estimated with NONMEM $PRIOR

limitations: Between-subject variability on Emax (the magnitude of CL decrease over time) (ω² 0.0572) is omitted because the engine does not support it.
The model was fitted only to second-line renal cell carcinoma patients, so it has no tumour-type term. Its eGFR effect (0.306) is also larger than in the pooled models (0.14~0.17).

The IV comparator's 'Cmax1' is read as the maximum over the first 28-day cycle (two IV doses), which is how the source's number is reproduced; the steady-state IV Cmax runs about 15% below the reported GM.
The validation values are patient geometric means, so they are compared against a single representative patient (median weight and eGFR, PS ≥1, male).
Time units were converted from hours (h) to days: CL and Q ×24, T50 ÷24, ka ×24.

OPDIVO QVANTIG US label, BLA 761381, revised 12/2024 12.3 — volume of distribution at steady state 6.8 L (27%); FDA recommended the IV-label value (FDA Multi-disciplinary Review BLA 761381/761429 (OPDIVO QVANTIG, Reference ID 5502908) p.60). Interval from the CV.
OPDIVO QVANTIG US label, BLA 761381, revised 12/2024 12.3 — 'elimination half-life is 25 days (78%)'. Computed from the late (steady-state) parameters. Interval from the CV.

timeVarying.source: FDA Multi-disciplinary Review BLA 761381/761429 (OPDIVO QVANTIG, Reference ID 5502908) Table 2 (PDF pp.188-189): CA20967T final popPK model — CLEMAX -0.260 (RSE 5.69%), CLT50 1.41E+03 h = 58.75 days, CLHILL 3.39. Form from Zhao et al. 2025, CPT Pharmacometrics Syst Pharmacol 14:2107-2117 (doi:10.1002/psp4.70120, PMC12706396) File S1: 'CL_TIME = EXP(EMAX*TIME**HILL/(T50**HILL+TIME**HILL))'.
desc: CL(t) = CL0 * exp(-0.260 * t^3.39 / (58.75^3.39 + t^3.39)): maximum decrease 23% (exp(-0.26) = 0.771), half reached at about day 59.
